name: Temporary WP-MVP-0005 clean execution rebuild

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - ops/wp-mvp-0005-clean-exec-rebuild

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  rebuild:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out clean execution lineage
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: recovery/wp-mvp-0005-clean-exec
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure commit identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Restore exact reviewed parser source
        run: |
          git fetch origin 561b24d1296ba26426dc1f817d22f280ba927f3d
          git checkout 561b24d1296ba26426dc1f817d22f280ba927f3d -- crates/monad-core/src/config.rs

      - name: Validate parser source
        run: |
          cargo fmt --all
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo test -p monad-core
          cargo clippy -p monad-core --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -A clippy::large_enum_variant
          git diff --check -- crates/monad-core/src/

      - name: Regenerate deterministic projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check

      - name: Enforce EXEC-0010 implementation boundary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          BASE=12750d1ace8df46587be3d816ef8d4e09b31eda1
          git add crates/monad-core/src machine
          changed="$(git diff --name-only "$BASE" --; git diff --cached --name-only)"
          changed="$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | sed '/^$/d' | sort -u)"
          printf '%s\n' "$changed"
          if printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -Eq '^\.eos(/|$)|^(idea\.md|vision/|product/|architecture/|specifications/|governance/|engineering/increments/|engineering/work-cycles/|engineering/work-packets/)'; then
            echo "EXEC-0010 baseline diff contains forbidden/governed implementation paths" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          expected='crates/monad-core/src/config.rs|crates/monad-core/src/discovery.rs|crates/monad-core/src/identity.rs|crates/monad-core/src/lib.rs|crates/monad-core/src/workspace.rs|machine/'
          unexpected="$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -Ev "^(${expected})" || true)"
          if [ -n "$unexpected" ]; then
            echo "Unexpected EXEC-0010 implementation paths:" >&2
            printf '%s\n' "$unexpected" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Commit clean reviewed result
        run: |
          git add crates/monad-core/src machine
          git diff --cached --check -- crates/monad-core/src/
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "fix(core): finalize reviewed structured config parser"
          fi
          git push origin HEAD:recovery/wp-mvp-0005-clean-exec

metadata.title: Tmp Wp Mvp 0005 Clean Exec Rebuild
